if Shop1Manager == nil then
    Shop1Manager = class({})
end

Shop1Managers = {}

Shop1Manager._event_registered = Shop1Manager._event_registered or false

Shop1Managers.debug = Shop1Managers.debug or false
Shop1Managers.motion_debug = Shop1Managers.motion_debug or false

Shop1Managers.level_map = { [1] = 1, [2] = 10, [3] = 20, [4] = 30 }
require("spawn_wall_manager")

function Shop1Managers:InitPlayer(pid)
    local mgr
    if not Shop1Managers[pid] then
        mgr = Shop1Manager()
        mgr.pid = pid
        Shop1Managers[pid] = mgr
    end

    mgr = Shop1Managers[pid]


    if not mgr.Slots then
        mgr.Slots = {}
    end

    for key, entindex in pairs(GameState.spawn_points[pid].good) do
        mgr.Slots[key] = -1
    end


    mgr:Start()
end

function Shop1Manager:Start()
    local raw = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/shop config/shop1.txt")

    if not raw then
        return
    end

    -- 兼容两种写法："ShopItems" 根 或者直接是条目
    local kv = raw.ShopItems or raw

    self:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self:BuildEquipPool()
    self:RegisterShopEvents()
    self:SyncToClient()
end

function Shop1Manager:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self.items = {}

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    for idStr, data in pairs(kv) do
        local id = tonumber(idStr)
        if id then
            local base_price   = tonumber(data.price) or 0
            local price_factor = tonumber(data.price_factor) or 1.0
            local unlock_delay = tonumber(data.unlock_time) or 0
            local grade        = tonumber(data.grade) or 1
            local name         = data.name or ""

            local price_table  = {}
            if data.price_table then
                for key, value in pairs(data.price_table) do
                    price_table[tonumber(key)] = tonumber(value)
                end
            end

            self.items[id] = {
                base_price   = base_price,         -- 初始价格
                price_factor = price_factor,       -- 价格倍率
                unlock_time  = now + unlock_delay, -- 解锁时间
                unlock_delay = unlock_delay,
                grade        = grade,              -- 商品等级（装备等级）
                buy_count    = 0,                  -- 已购买次数
                name         = name,
                price_table  = price_table
            }
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:BuildEquipPool()
    self.equip_pool = {}

    local added = {}

    if AbilityKV then
        for name, data in pairs(AbilityKV) do
            if type(data) == "table"
                and data.Shop == 1
                and data.Open == 1 then
                if not added[name] then
                    table.insert(self.equip_pool, name)
                    added[name] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RegisterShopEvents()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener(
        "shop_buy_request",
        function(_, keys) self:OnBuyRequest(keys) end
    )
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener(
        "shop1_click_select",
        function(_, keys) self:OnClickSelect(keys) end
    )
end

function Shop1Managers:DebugLog(...)
    if self.debug then
        print("[Shop1Manager]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:MotionLog(...)
    if self.motion_debug then
        print("[Shop1Motion]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:GetDummyLevel(lvl)
    return self.level_map[lvl] or 1
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 当前价格（带购买次数和倍率）
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    id = tonumber(id)
    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg or not cfg.price_table then return 0 end

    local count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
    if count < 1 then count = 1 end

    local price = cfg.price_table[count]
    if price == nil then
        local max_count = 0
        for key, _ in pairs(cfg.price_table) do
            if key > max_count then
                max_count = key
            end
        end
        price = cfg.price_table[max_count] or cfg.base_price or 0
    end

    return math.floor(price)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 同步数据到客户端 UI
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:SyncToClient()
    local data_items = {}

    for id, cfg in pairs(self.items) do
        data_items[id] = {
            price        = self:GetCurrentPrice(id),
            unlock_time  = cfg.unlock_time,
            unlock_delay = cfg.unlock_delay,
            grade        = cfg.grade,     -- 商品等级（装备等级）
            level        = cfg.buy_count, -- 用作 UI 显示“购买次数”的话
            name         = cfg.name,
        }
    end

    local data = { items = data_items }
    if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetClientState then
        data.enhance = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(self.pid)
    end

    local pid = self.pid

    if pid then
        local p = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
        if p then
            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(p, "shop_data_update", data)
        end
        return
    end

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("shop_data_update", data)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 购买请求

function Shop1Manager:OnBuyRequest(keys)
    local pid = keys.PlayerID
    if self.pid ~= pid then
        return
    end

    local id = tonumber(keys.id)

    if not id then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: invalid id", keys.id)
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then return end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then return end

    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: no config for id", id)
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 解锁时间检查
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if now < cfg.unlock_time then
        print("[Shop] id", id, "not unlocked yet")
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 金币检查 & 扣费
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local price = self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    local gold  = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")

    if gold < price then
        print("[Shop] not enough gold, need", price, "have", gold)
        return
    end

    PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)

    cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 随机一件装备

function Shop1Manager:SelectNearestDummyByPos(pos, radius)
    if not pos then return end
    local bestEnt = nil
    local bestDist = nil
    for _, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if data and data ~= -1 then
            local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
            if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then

                local proxyIndex = dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy
                if proxyIndex then

                    if proxy and not proxy:IsNull() then

                end

function Shop1Manager:GetMaxDragDistance()

function Shop1Manager:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(data)

    end
    local autocast = data.Autocast
    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        autocast.is_paused = true
    end

function Shop1Manager:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not dataA or not dataB then return false end
    if dataA.Moving or dataB.Moving then return false end

    local levelA = self:GetDataLevel(dataA)
    local levelB = self:GetDataLevel(dataB)
    if not levelA or not levelB or levelA ~= levelB then return false end
    if levelA >= 4 then return false end

    local nameA = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataA)
    local nameB = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataB)
    if not nameA or not nameB or nameA ~= nameB then return false end

    return true, levelA
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB, targetSlot)
    if not slotA or not slotB then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotA]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotB]

            end
        else
            Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no hero", slotA, slotB)
        end
    end)

    if not slotMover or not slotTarget then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotMover]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotTarget]

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotMover, slotTarget }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]
    end

    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataA)
    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataB)

    local motion = self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local function ResolveSlotByData(findData)
        for slot, v in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if v == findData then
                return slot
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local done = 0
    local expected = moveBoth and 2 or 1
    local function finishOne()
        done = done + 1
        if done < expected then return end

        local slotA = ResolveSlotByData(dataA) or slotMover
        local slotB = ResolveSlotByData(dataB) or slotTarget

        local entA = dataA and dataA.Dummy or nil
        local entB = dataB and dataB.Dummy or nil

        self.Slots[slotA] = -1

        Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()

end

local M = {}

local default_stats = {}

function M.HasBehavior(behavior, flag)
    return behavior and string.find(behavior, flag, 1, true)
end

function M.ResolveCastBehavior(ability_kv)
    local behavior = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""
    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT") then
        return "Position"
    end

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET") then
        local target_team = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityUnitTargetTeam or ""
        if M.HasBehavior(target_team, "DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_FRIENDLY") then
            return "Self"
        end
        return "Target"
    end

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") then
        return "NoTarget"
    end

    return "NoTarget"
end

function M.ParseAbilityCastRange(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local cast_range = ability_kv.AbilityCastRange
    if type(cast_range) == "number" then
        return cast_range
    end
    if type(cast_range) == "string" and cast_range ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(cast_range, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

function M.ParseAbilityDuration(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local dur = ability_kv.AbilityDuration
    if type(dur) == "number" then
        return dur
    end
    if type(dur) == "string" and dur ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(dur, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

function M.GetAbilityCastRange(profile, pos, owner)
    if not profile or not profile.skill then
        return 0
    end
    local ability = profile.skill
    local range = 0
    if ability.GetCastRange then
        range = ability:GetCastRange(pos or Vector(0, 0, 0), owner or ability:GetCaster())
    end
    if range and range > 0 then
        return range
    end
    return M.ParseAbilityCastRange(profile.skill_kv or ability:GetAbilityKeyValues())
end

function M.ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability, use_direct_cast)
    if not parent or not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    local ability_kv = ability:GetAbilityKeyValues() or {}
    local behavior = ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_TOGGLE") or M.HasBehavior(behavior, "TOGGLE") then
        ability:ToggleAbility()
        return
    end

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_AUTOCAST") or M.HasBehavior(behavior, "AUTOCAST") then
        if not ability:GetAutoCastState() then
            ability:ToggleAutoCast()
        end
        return
    end

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") or M.HasBehavior(behavior, "NO_TARGET") then
        if use_direct_cast then
            parent:CastAbilityNoTarget(ability, parent:GetPlayerID())
        else
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = parent:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end
    end
end

function M.IsUnitBusy(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    local function IgnoreBusyForActiveAbility(active_ability)
        if not active_ability or active_ability:IsNull() then
            return false
        end
        if not unit.HasModifier or not unit.GetCurrentActiveAbility then
            return false
        end

        -- Crystal Maiden's Freezing Field with Aghanim's Scepter allows actions during the channel
        local has_scepter = unit:HasModifier("modifier_item_ultimate_scepter")
        local ability_name = active_ability.GetAbilityName and active_ability:GetAbilityName() or ""
        return has_scepter and ability_name == "crystal_maiden_freezing_field"
    end

    local active_ability = unit.GetCurrentActiveAbility and unit:GetCurrentActiveAbility() or nil
    local ignore_busy = IgnoreBusyForActiveAbility(active_ability)

    if unit.IsAttacking and unit:IsAttacking() then
        return true
    end
    if unit.IsChanneling and unit:IsChanneling() then
        if not ignore_busy then
            return true
        end
    end
    if unit.IsCastingAbility and unit:IsCastingAbility() then
        if not ignore_busy then
            return true
        end
    end
    if active_ability and not active_ability:IsNull() then
        return not ignore_busy
    end
    return false
end

function M.GetPlayerStats(owner)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() or (not owner:IsRealHero()) then
        return default_stats
    end

    local pid = owner:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    if not pid or pid < 0 then
        return default_stats
    end

    local stats = PlayerStats and PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid) or nil
    if not stats then
        return default_stats
    end

    return PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid)
end

function M.NormalizeName(value)
    if value and value ~= "" and value ~= "none" then
        return value
    end
    return nil
end

function M.ToNumber(value)
    if value == nil or value == "" then
        return nil
    end
    return tonumber(value)
end

return M

}

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function GetInvokerLevels(dummy_level)
    if not dummy_level or dummy_level <= 0 then
        return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[1]
    end
    return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[dummy_level] or INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[#INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS]
end

local function ParseCombo(combo)
    if type(combo) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local counts = { quas = 0, wex = 0, exort = 0 }
    for orb in string.gmatch(combo, "%S+") do
        if counts[orb] ~= nil then
            counts[orb] = counts[orb] + 1
        end
    end
    return counts
end

local function AddToSlots(state, name)
    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
        if slot == name then
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(state.slots, name)
    if #state.slots > 2 then
        table.remove(state.slots, 1)
    end
end

local function EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)
    local levels = GetInvokerLevels(context.dummy_level)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.invoker = context.special_state.invoker or { slots = {} }

    local quas = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_quas", levels.quas or 1)
    local wex = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_wex", levels.wex or 1)
    local exort = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_exort", levels.exort or 1)
    local invoke = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_invoke", 1)

    if (not quas) or (not wex) or (not exort) or (not invoke) then
        print(string.format(

            tostring(quas), tostring(wex), tostring(exort), tostring(invoke),
            tostring(context.parent and context.parent:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
            tostring(context.dummy_level)
        ))
        return nil, nil, nil, nil
    end

    return quas, wex, exort, invoke
end

local InvokerHandler = {}

function InvokerHandler:Init(context)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)
end

function InvokerHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not context.parent:IsAlive() then
        return false
    end
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end

    local combo = ParseCombo(INVOKER_COMBOS[profile.projectile_name])
    if not combo then
        return false
    end

    local quas, wex, exort, invoke = EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)

    if not quas or not wex or not exort then
        return false
    end

    if not invoke then
        return false
    end

    local state = context.special_state and context.special_state.invoker
    if state and state.slots then
        for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
            if slot == profile.projectile_name then
                return false
            end
        end
    end

    local function QueueOrb(orb, count)
        if not orb or count <= 0 then
            return
        end
        for _ = 1, count do
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = context.parent:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = orb:entindex(),
                Queue = true,
            })
        end
    end

    QueueOrb(quas, combo.quas or 0)
    QueueOrb(wex, combo.wex or 0)
    QueueOrb(exort, combo.exort or 0)

    if invoke then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = context.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = invoke:entindex(),
            Queue = true,
        })
    end

    if state then
        AddToSlots(state, profile.projectile_name)
    end

    return true
end

return InvokerHandler

    if not self.special_handler or not self.special_handler.AfterCast then
        return
    end

    local handler = self.special_handler
    self.aftercast_timers = self.aftercast_timers or {}
    local id = Timers:CreateTimer(0.2, function()
        if not self or not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
            return nil
        end
        handler:AfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
        return nil
    end)
    table.insert(self.aftercast_timers, id)
end

        self.additional_passives = self.parent.__autocast_additional_passives

    print("[Autocast Create]", self.projectile_name, self.projectile_interval, self.projectile_sp,
        self.projectile_sp_interval, self.projectile_sp_2, self.projectile_sp_2_interval)

    if autocast_specials and autocast_specials.GetHandler then

    end

    end

        level = self.projectile_level,
        interval = self.projectile_interval,
        range = self.projectile_range,

        damage_scale = self.projectile_damage_scale or 1,
        pure_percent = self.pure_percent or 0,
        lifesteal = self.lifesteal_sp or 0,
        dummy_mode = self.projectile_dummy_mode,
    })

    self:InitProjectileProfile({
        name = self.projectile_sp,
        level = self.projectile_sp_level,
        interval = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        range = self.projectile_sp_range,
        base_damage = self.projectile_sp_base_damage or 0,
        damage_scale = self.projectile_sp_damage_scale or 1,

    })

        name = self.projectile_sp_2,
        level = self.projectile_sp_2_level,
        interval = self.projectile_sp_2_interval,
        range = self.projectile_sp_2_range,
        base_damage = self.projectile_sp_2_base_damage or 0,
        damage_scale = self.projectile_sp_2_damage_scale or 1,
        pure_percent = self.projectile_sp_2_purePercent or 0,
        lifesteal = self.lifesteal_sp or 0,
        dummy_mode = self.projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode,
    })

    if self.additional_projectiles then
        for _, slot in ipairs(self.additional_projectiles) do
            self:InitProjectileProfile({
                name = slot.name,
                level = slot.level,
                interval = slot.interval,
                range = slot.range,
                base_damage = slot.base_damage or 0,
                damage_scale = slot.damage_scale or 1,
                pure_percent = slot.pure_percent or 0,
                lifesteal = self.lifesteal_sp or 0,
                dummy_mode = slot.dummy_mode,
            })
        end
    end

    if self:HasCloneProfile() then
        self:EnsureCloneUnit()
        self:DeactivateClone()
    end

    if self.parent and not self.parent:IsNull() then
        self.attrs_mod = self.parent:AddNewModifier(self.parent, self.ability, "modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs", {
            prevent_death = self.prevent_death or 0,
        })
    end

    if self.passive_name then
        local passive = self.parent:AddAbility(self.passive_name)
        if passive then
            if self.passive_level then
                passive:SetLevel(self.passive_level)
            else
                passive:SetLevel(1)
            end

            passive:SetActivated(true)
            ActivatePassiveAbility(self.parent, passive)
        end
    end

    if self.passive_sp then
        local passive = self.parent:AddAbility(self.passive_sp)
        if passive then
            if self.passive_sp_level then
                passive:SetLevel(self.passive_sp_level)
            else
                passive:SetLevel(1)
            end

            passive:SetActivated(true)
            ActivatePassiveAbility(self.parent, passive)
        end
    end

        local passive = self.parent:AddAbility(self.passive_sp_2)
        if passive then
            if self.passive_sp_2_level then
                passive:SetLevel(self.passive_sp_2_level)
            else
                passive:SetLevel(1)
            end

            passive:SetActivated(true)
            ActivatePassiveAbility(self.parent, passive)
        end
    end

    if self.additional_passives then
        for _, passive_cfg in ipairs(self.additional_passives) do
            if passive_cfg and passive_cfg.name then
                local passive = self.parent:AddAbility(passive_cfg.name)
                if passive then
                    if passive_cfg.level and tonumber(passive_cfg.level) then
                        passive:SetLevel(tonumber(passive_cfg.level))
                    else
                        passive:SetLevel(1)
                    end

                    passive:SetActivated(true)
                    ActivatePassiveAbility(self.parent, passive)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if self.ability_sp then
        local sp = self.parent:AddAbility(self.ability_sp)
        if sp then
            sp:SetLevel(1)
            sp:SetActivated(true)
        end
    end

    if self.modifier_sp then
        if not self.mod then
            self.mod = self.parent:AddNewModifier(self.parent, nil, self.modifier_sp, {})
        end
    end

    self.listener_id = ListenToGameEvent(
        "hero_fake_death",
        function(keys) self:OnFakeDeathStateChanged(keys) end,
        nil
    )

    self:StartProjectileTimers()
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end


    -- 【新增】移除监听器
    if self.listener_id then
        StopListeningToGameEvent(self.listener_id)
        self.listener_id = nil
    end

    if self.modifier_sp and self.mod and self.parent and not self.parent:IsNull() then
        self.parent:RemoveModifierByName(self.modifier_sp)
        self.modifier_sp = nil
        self.mod = nil
    end
    if self.attrs_mod and not self.attrs_mod:IsNull() and self.parent and not self.parent:IsNull() then
        self.parent:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
        self.attrs_mod = nil
    end

    if self.timer_handles then
        for _, id in ipairs(self.timer_handles) do
            Timers:RemoveTimer(id)
        end
        self.timer_handles = nil
    end
    if self.follow_timer_handles then
        for _, id in ipairs(self.follow_timer_handles) do
            Timers:RemoveTimer(id)
        end
        self.follow_timer_handles = nil
    end
    if self.aftercast_timers then
        for _, id in ipairs(self.aftercast_timers) do
            Timers:RemoveTimer(id)
        end
        self.aftercast_timers = nil
    end

    if self.clone_dummies then
        for _, dummy in ipairs(self.clone_dummies) do
            if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                dummy:Destroy()
            end
        end
        self.clone_dummies = nil
    end

    if self.clone_unit and not self.clone_unit:IsNull() then
        self.clone_unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
        self.clone_unit:Destroy()
        self.clone_unit = nil
        self.clone_mod = nil
        self.clone_attrs_mod = nil
    end
    if self.clone_pause_timer then
        Timers:RemoveTimer(self.clone_pause_timer)
        self.clone_pause_timer = nil
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:HasCloneProfile()
    if not self.projectiles then return false end
    for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if profile.dummy_mode == "clone" then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:EnsureCloneUnit()
    if self.clone_unit and not self.clone_unit:IsNull() and self.clone_unit:IsAlive() then
        return self.clone_unit
    end

    local dummy_name = self.parent and self.parent:GetUnitName() or "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy"
    local clone = CreateUnitByName(
        dummy_name,
        Vector(10000, 10000, 0),
        false,
        self.owner,
        self.owner,
        self.owner:GetTeamNumber()
    )

    if not clone then return nil end

    clone:SetOwner(self.owner)
    clone:SetControllableByPlayer(self.owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
    local lvl = self.parent and self.parent:GetLevel() or 1
    if lvl > 1 then
        clone:CreatureLevelUp(lvl - 1)
    end

    clone:AddNewModifier(clone, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
    clone:AddNewModifier(clone, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
    clone:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
    clone:AddNoDraw()
    clone.__autocast_additional_projectiles = self.additional_projectiles
    clone.__autocast_additional_passives = self.additional_passives
    self.clone_attrs_mod = clone:AddNewModifier(clone, self.ability, "modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs", {
        prevent_death = 1,
    })

    self.clone_mod = clone:AddNewModifier(self.owner, self.ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", {
        hero_name                   = self.hero_name,
        dummy_level                 = lvl,
        projectile_name             = self.projectile_name,
        projectile_level            = self.projectile_level,
        projectile_interval         = self.projectile_interval,
        projectile_range            = self.projectile_range,
        projectile_base_damage      = self.projectile_base_damage,
        projectile_damage_scale      = self.projectile_damage_scale,
        heal_percent                = self.heal_percent,
        pure_percent                = self.pure_percent,
        projectile_dummy_mode       = "none",

        projectile_sp               = self.projectile_sp,
        projectile_sp_level         = self.projectile_sp_level,
        projectile_sp_interval      = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        projectile_sp_range         = self.projectile_sp_range,
        projectile_sp_base_damage   = self.projectile_sp_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_damage_scale  = self.projectile_sp_damage_scale,
        projectile_sp_purePercent   = self.projectile_sp_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_dummy_mode    = "none",

        projectile_sp_2             = self.projectile_sp_2,
        projectile_sp_2_level       = self.projectile_sp_2_level,
        projectile_sp_2_interval    = self.projectile_sp_2_interval,
        projectile_sp_2_range       = self.projectile_sp_2_range,
        projectile_sp_2_base_damage = self.projectile_sp_2_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_2_damage_scale    = self.projectile_sp_2_damage_scale,
        projectile_sp_2_purePercent = self.projectile_sp_2_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode  = "none",

        passive_name                = self.passive_name,
        passive_level               = self.passive_level,
        passive_sp                  = self.passive_sp,
        passive_sp_level            = self.passive_sp_level,
        passive_sp_2                = self.passive_sp_2,
        passive_sp_2_level          = self.passive_sp_2_level,

        ability_sp                  = self.ability_sp,
        modifier_sp                 = self.modifier_sp,
        lifesteal_sp                = self.lifesteal_sp,
        prevent_death               = 1,
    })

    self.clone_unit = clone
    return clone
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:ScheduleClonePause(ttl)
    if self.clone_pause_timer then
        Timers:RemoveTimer(self.clone_pause_timer)
    end
    self.clone_pause_timer = Timers:CreateTimer(ttl, function()
        self:DeactivateClone()
    end)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:ActivateClone()
    if not self.clone_unit or self.clone_unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    self.clone_active = true
    local was_hidden = not self.clone_visible
    DebugClone("[Clone] Activate", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "was_hidden", was_hidden)
    if self.clone_unit:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        self.clone_unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_invulnerable")
    end
    if self.clone_unit:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        self.clone_unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_no_healthbar")
    end
    self.clone_unit:RemoveNoDraw()
    self.clone_visible = true
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:DeactivateClone()
    if not self.clone_unit or self.clone_unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if IsUnitBusy(self.clone_unit) then
        DebugClone("[DeactivateClone] delayed (busy)", GameRules:GetGameTime())
        if self.clone_pause_timer then
            Timers:RemoveTimer(self.clone_pause_timer)
        end
        self.clone_pause_timer = Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
            self:DeactivateClone()
        end)
        return
    end
    self.clone_active = false
    self.clone_visible = false
    if self.clone_mod and not self.clone_mod:IsNull() then
        self.clone_mod.is_paused = true
    end
    if not self.clone_unit:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        self.clone_unit:AddNewModifier(self.clone_unit, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    end
    if not self.clone_unit:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        self.clone_unit:AddNewModifier(self.clone_unit, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    end
    self.clone_unit:AddNoDraw()
    if self.clone_unit.SetForceAttackTarget then
        self.clone_unit:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
    end
    self.clone_unit:SetIdleAcquire(false)
    self.clone_unit:SetAcquisitionRange(0)
    self.clone_unit:Stop()
    self.clone_unit:SetAbsOrigin(Vector(10000, 10000, 0))
    self.clone_unit:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)

    DebugClone("[DeactivateClone]", GameRules:GetGameTime())
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:IsCloneActive()
    if not self.clone_active then
        return false
    end
    if not self.clone_unit or self.clone_unit:IsNull() or not self.clone_unit:IsAlive() then
        self.clone_active = false
        return false
    end
    return true
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:IsCloneAvailable()
    if not self:IsCloneActive() then
        return false
    end
    return not IsUnitBusy(self.clone_unit)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnFakeDeathStateChanged(event_table)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    -- Ensure the event targets this modifier's owner.
    if event_table.entindex ~= self.owner:entindex() then
        return
    end

    local is_dead = event_table.is_dead

    if is_dead == 1 then -- fake death start
        self.is_paused = true

        if self.projectiles then
            for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
                if profile.skill then
                    profile.skill:SetActivated(false)
                end
            end
        end
    elseif is_dead == 0 then -- fake death end
        self.is_paused = false

        if self.projectiles then
            for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
                if profile.skill then
                    profile.skill:SetActivated(true)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetFinalInterval(base)
    local s = GetPlayerStats(self.owner)

    if not base or base <= 0 then
        return 0.05
    end

    local pct = 1 + BpToFlat(s.ProjectileCooldown or 0)

    local final = base / pct

    if final < 0.05 then
        final = 0.05
    end

    return final
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetFinalCastRange(base)
    local s = GetPlayerStats(self.owner)
    local range = base or 0
    local final = range + (s.ProjectileRange or 0)

    return final
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:FirePseudoTrackingProjectile(profile, target)
    if not target or target:IsNull() then return end
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then return end
    if not self.ability or self.ability:IsNull() then return end

    -- Keep dummy on the hero.
    self.parent:SetAbsOrigin(self.owner:GetAbsOrigin())
    self.parent:FaceTowards(target:GetAbsOrigin())

    local proj_speed = 900

    local info = {
        Target     = target,
        Source     = self.owner,
        Ability    = self.ability,
        EffectName = self.ability:GetAbilityKeyValues().ProjectileModel,
        iMoveSpeed = proj_speed,
        bDodgeable = true,
        bIsAttack  = false,
        ExtraData  = {
            owner_entindex = self.owner:entindex(),
            dummy_entindex = self.parent:entindex(),
            base_damage    = profile.base_damage,
            damage_scale   = profile.damage_scale,
            hit_label      = profile.hit_label,
            proj_speed     = proj_speed,

            spawn_time     = GameRules:GetGameTime(),
            max_time       = 2,
        }
    }

    local proj_id = ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile(info)
    info.ExtraData.projectile_id = proj_id
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:InitProjectileProfile(params)
    if not params then return end
    local name = params.name
    if not name or name == "" or name == "none" then return end
    if not params.interval or params.interval <= 0 then return end

    local is_attack = (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack")
    local profile = {
        projectile_name = name,
        interval = params.interval,
        range = params.range or 0,
        base_damage = params.base_damage or 0,
        damage_scale = params.damage_scale or 1,
        pure_percent = params.pure_percent or 0,
        lifesteal = params.lifesteal or 0,
        hit_label = hit_label,
        is_attack = is_attack,
        attack_mode = (name == "ranged_attack" and "ranged" or "melee"),
        dummy_mode = (not is_attack and params.dummy_mode) or nil,
        next_cast_time = 0,
    }

    -- print("[InitProjectileProfile]", name, params.interval, params.base_damage, params.damage_scale)

    if not profile.is_attack then
        profile.skill = self.parent:AddAbility(name)
        if profile.skill then
            profile.skill:SetLevel(1)
            if params.level and params.level > 1 then
                profile.skill:SetLevel(params.level)
            end
            profile.skill:SetActivated(true)
            profile.skill_kv = profile.skill:GetAbilityKeyValues()
            profile.behavior = ResolveCastBehavior(profile.skill_kv)
            profile.follow_facing = tostring(profile.skill_kv.AutoCastFollowFacing or "") == "1"
            profile.ability_duration = ParseAbilityDuration(profile.skill_kv)
        end
    else
        profile.behavior = "Target"
    end

    table.insert(self.projectiles, profile)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:StartFollowFacingTimer(profile)
    if not profile or not profile.follow_facing then return end
    self.follow_timer_handles = self.follow_timer_handles or {}
    local id = Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        return self:OnFollowFacingThink(profile)
    end)
    table.insert(self.follow_timer_handles, id)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnFollowFacingThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not profile or not profile.follow_facing then return 0.1 end
    if self.is_paused then return 0.1 end
    if not profile.follow_facing_active then return 0.1 end
    if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then return 0.1 end

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if profile.follow_facing_end_time and profile.follow_facing_end_time > 0 and now > profile.follow_facing_end_time then
        profile.follow_facing_active = nil
        return 0.1
    end

    if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsInAbilityPhase() and not profile.skill:IsChanneling() then
        local active = self.parent.GetCurrentActiveAbility and self.parent:GetCurrentActiveAbility() or nil
        if not active or active ~= profile.skill then
            profile.follow_facing_active = nil
            return 0.1
        end
    end

    local target = profile.follow_facing_target
    if target and not target:IsNull() then
        profile.follow_facing_pos = target:GetAbsOrigin()
    end

    if profile.follow_facing_pos then
        self.parent:FaceTowards(profile.follow_facing_pos)
    end
    return 0.03
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval)
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then return nil end
    if not profile then return nil end
    if profile.is_attack and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Target" and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Position" and not pos then return nil end

    local clone = self:EnsureCloneUnit()

    if not clone then return nil end

    local move_clone = profile.dummy_mode == "clone"
    if move_clone then
        local final_pos = pos or (enemy and enemy:GetAbsOrigin()) or self.owner:GetAbsOrigin()
        clone:SetAbsOrigin(final_pos)
    end
    if pos and not move_clone then
        clone:SetCursorPosition(pos)
        clone:FaceTowards(pos)
    elseif enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
        clone:FaceTowards(enemy:GetAbsOrigin())
    end
    self:ActivateClone()
    if self.clone_mod and not self.clone_mod:IsNull() then
        self.clone_mod.is_paused = true
    end
    DebugClone("[CloneCast] name", profile.projectile_name, "mode", tostring(profile.dummy_mode), "move_clone",
        move_clone)

    if profile.is_attack then
        local use_projectile = (profile.attack_mode == "ranged")
        local clone_pos = clone:GetAbsOrigin()

            profile.behavior = ResolveCastBehavior(profile.skill_kv)
            profile.follow_facing = tostring(profile.skill_kv.AutoCastFollowFacing or "") == "1"
            profile.ability_duration = ParseAbilityDuration(profile.skill_kv)
        end
    else
        profile.behavior = "Target"
    end

    table.insert(self.projectiles, profile)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:StartFollowFacingTimer(profile)
    if not profile or not profile.follow_facing then return end
    self.follow_timer_handles = self.follow_timer_handles or {}
    local id = Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        return self:OnFollowFacingThink(profile)
    end)
    table.insert(self.follow_timer_handles, id)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnFollowFacingThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not profile or not profile.follow_facing then return 0.1 end
    if self.is_paused then return 0.1 end
    if not profile.follow_facing_active then return 0.1 end
    if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then return 0.1 end

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if profile.follow_facing_end_time and profile.follow_facing_end_time > 0 and now > profile.follow_facing_end_time then
        profile.follow_facing_active = nil
        return 0.1
    end

    if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsInAbilityPhase() and not profile.skill:IsChanneling() then
        local active = self.parent.GetCurrentActiveAbility and self.parent:GetCurrentActiveAbility() or nil
        if not active or active ~= profile.skill then
            profile.follow_facing_active = nil
            return 0.1
        end
    end

    local target = profile.follow_facing_target
    if target and not target:IsNull() then
        profile.follow_facing_pos = target:GetAbsOrigin()
    end

    if profile.follow_facing_pos then
        self.parent:FaceTowards(profile.follow_facing_pos)
    end
    return 0.03
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval)
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then return nil end
    if not profile then return nil end
    if profile.is_attack and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Target" and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Position" and not pos then return nil end

    local clone = self:EnsureCloneUnit()

    if not clone then return nil end

    local move_clone = profile.dummy_mode == "clone"
    if move_clone then
        local final_pos = pos or (enemy and enemy:GetAbsOrigin()) or self.owner:GetAbsOrigin()
        clone:SetAbsOrigin(final_pos)
    end
    if pos and not move_clone then
        clone:SetCursorPosition(pos)
        clone:FaceTowards(pos)
    elseif enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
        clone:FaceTowards(enemy:GetAbsOrigin())
    end
    self:ActivateClone()
    if self.clone_mod and not self.clone_mod:IsNull() then
        self.clone_mod.is_paused = true
    end
    DebugClone("[CloneCast] name", profile.projectile_name, "mode", tostring(profile.dummy_mode), "move_clone",
        move_clone)

    if profile.is_attack then
        local use_projectile = (profile.attack_mode == "ranged")
        local clone_pos = clone:GetAbsOrigin()
        local enemy_pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()
        local dist = (enemy_pos - clone_pos):Length2D()
        local atk_range = clone:Script_GetAttackRange()
        DebugClone("[PerformAttack]", clone:GetUnitName(), "Time", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "Distance", dist, "AtkRange",
            atk_range)
        local attrs_mod = self.clone_attrs_mod
        if not attrs_mod or attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            attrs_mod = clone:FindModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
            self.clone_attrs_mod = attrs_mod
        end
        if attrs_mod and not attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(profile.range)
            autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackOverride(attrs_mod, clone, self.parent, range, interval)
        end
        if clone.RemoveGesture then
            clone:RemoveGesture(ACT_DOTA_IDLE)
        end
        if clone.StartGesture then
            clone:StartGesture(ACT_DOTA_ATTACK)
        end
        clone:PerformAttack(
            enemy,
            true,           -- bUseCastAttackOrb
            true,           -- bProcessProcs
            true,           -- bSkipCooldown
            false,          -- bIgnoreInvis
            use_projectile, -- bUseProjectile
            false,          -- bFakeAttack
            true            -- bNeverMiss
        )
        DebugClone("[PerformAttack] After", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "IsAttacking",
            clone.IsAttacking and clone:IsAttacking())
    else
        local ab = clone:FindAbilityByName(profile.projectile_name)
        if not ab then
            ab = clone:AddAbility(profile.projectile_name)
            if ab then
                ab:SetLevel(1)
                ab:SetActivated(true)
            end
        end
        if not ab then
            return nil
        end


        if profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Self" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Position" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                Position = pos,
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end
    end

    if profile.dummy_mode == "clone" then
        local ttl = 0
        if profile.skill and profile.skill.GetSpecialValueFor then
            local dur = profile.skill:GetSpecialValueFor("duration")
            if dur and dur > 0 then
                ttl = dur
            end
        end
        if ttl <= 0 then
            ttl = math.max(interval or 0, 0.2)
        end
        self.clone_pause_until = math.max(self.clone_pause_until or 0, GameRules:GetGameTime() + ttl)
        self:ScheduleClonePause(ttl)
    end

    return clone
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:StartProjectileTimers()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not self.projectiles or #self.projectiles == 0 then return end

    self.timer_handles = self.timer_handles or {}

    for idx, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        local offset = 0
        local id = Timers:CreateTimer(offset, function()
            return self:OnProjectileThink(profile)
        end)
        table.insert(self.timer_handles, id)
        self:StartFollowFacingTimer(profile)
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnProjectileThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    if self.is_paused then
        return 0.1
    end
    if self.parent and self.parent.__autocast_destroying then
        return 0.1
    end
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    if not profile then
        return 0.1
    end

    if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end

    if (not profile.is_attack and not profile.skill) or (not self.owner) or (self.owner:IsNull()) then
        return 0.1
    end

    if profile.next_cast_time and profile.next_cast_time > now then
        return math.max(0.05, profile.next_cast_time - now)
    end

    if HasHigherPriorityReady(self, profile, now) then
        return 0.05
    end

    local clone_active = self:IsCloneActive()
    local clone_available = clone_active and not IsUnitBusy(self.clone_unit)
    if clone_active and not clone_available then
        DebugClone("[CloneBusy] use base", profile.projectile_name, GameRules:GetGameTime())
    end
    if IsUnitBusy(clone_available and self.clone_unit or self.parent) then
        return 0.1
    end

    local interval = self:GetFinalInterval(profile.interval)
    local use_clone = clone_available or profile.dummy_mode == "clone"

      if profile.behavior == "Self" then
          if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
              return 0.1
          end
          if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
              self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, self.owner, self.owner and self.owner:GetAbsOrigin())
          end
          local caster = self.parent
          local gesture = ResolveGestureFromKV(profile.skill_kv)
          if use_clone then
              PlayVisualGesture(self.parent, gesture, profile.ability_duration or 0.6)
              caster = self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, self.owner, self.owner:GetAbsOrigin(), interval) or self.parent
          else
              PlayVisualGesture(self.parent, gesture, profile.ability_duration or 0.6)
              ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                  UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
                  OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                  AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
                  TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
                  Queue = false,
              })
          end
          ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, self.owner, self.owner and self.owner:GetAbsOrigin(), caster)
          profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
          return interval
      end

    local origin = self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
    if profile.dummy_mode ~= "clone" and clone_available and self.clone_unit and not self.clone_unit:IsNull() then
        origin = self.clone_unit:GetAbsOrigin()
    end
    local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(profile.range)

    local cast_range = 0
    if not profile.is_attack and (profile.behavior == "Position" or profile.behavior == "Target") then
        cast_range = GetAbilityCastRange(profile, origin, self.owner)
        if cast_range > 0 then
            range = math.min(range, cast_range)
        end
    end

    local enemy = nil
    local pos = nil

    if profile.behavior == "Position" or profile.behavior == "Target" or profile.behavior == "NoTarget" or profile.is_attack then
        local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
            self.parent:GetTeamNumber(),
            origin,
            nil,
            range,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
            FIND_CLOSEST,
            false
        )

        if #enemies == 0 then
            return 0.1
        end

        enemy = enemies[1]
        pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()

        local dir = pos - origin
        dir.z = 0
        local minDist = range * 0.5
        local maxDist = range - 50
        local normal_dir = dir:Normalized()

        local dist = dir:Length2D()
        if dist < 150 then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * minDist
        end

        if dist > range then
            pos = origin + normal_dir * maxDist
        end
    end

    if profile.behavior == "Position" and pos and cast_range and cast_range > 0 then
        local dir = pos - origin
        dir.z = 0
        local dist = dir:Length2D()
        if dist > cast_range then
            local final = math.max(cast_range - 25, 0)
            pos = origin + dir:Normalized() * final
        end
    end

    if profile.is_attack then
        if use_clone then
            PlayVisualGesture(self.parent, ACT_DOTA_ATTACK, 0.3)
            self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval)
            profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
            return interval
        end
        local attrs_mod = self.attrs_mod
        if not attrs_mod or attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            attrs_mod = self.parent:FindModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
            self.attrs_mod = attrs_mod
        end
        if attrs_mod and not attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackOverride(attrs_mod, self.parent, self.parent, range, interval)
        end
        self.parent.__autocast_attack_profile = profile
        local use_projectile = (profile.attack_mode == "ranged")

        PlayVisualGesture(self.parent, ACT_DOTA_ATTACK, 0.3)
        self.parent:PerformAttack(
            enemy,
            true,           -- bUseCastAttackOrb
            true,           -- bProcessProcs
            true,           -- bSkipCooldown
            false,          -- bIgnoreInvis
            use_projectile, -- bUseProjectile
            false,          -- bFakeAttack
            true            -- bNeverMiss
        )
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
        return interval
    end

    if pos and not use_clone then
        self.parent:SetCursorPosition(pos)
        self.parent:FaceTowards(pos)
    end

      if profile.behavior == "Position" then
          if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
              return 0.1
          end
          if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
              self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, enemy, pos)
          end
          local caster = self.parent
          local gesture = ResolveGestureFromKV(profile.skill_kv)
          if use_clone then
              PlayVisualGesture(self.parent, gesture, profile.ability_duration or 0.6)
              caster = self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval) or self.parent
              ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
              profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
              return interval
          end

          PlayVisualGesture(self.parent, gesture, profile.ability_duration or 0.6)
          ExecuteOrderFromTable({
              UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
              OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
              AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
              Position = pos,
              Queue = false,
          })
          ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
          if profile.follow_facing then
              profile.follow_facing_active = true
              profile.follow_facing_pos = pos
              profile.follow_facing_target = enemy
              if profile.ability_duration and profile.ability_duration > 0 then
                profile.follow_facing_end_time = now + profile.ability_duration
            else
                profile.follow_facing_end_time = nil
            end
        end
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
      elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then
          if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
              return 0.1
          end
          if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
              self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, enemy, pos)
          end
          local caster = self.parent
          local gesture = ResolveGestureFromKV(profile.skill_kv)
          if use_clone then
              PlayVisualGesture(self.parent, gesture, profile.ability_duration or 0.6)
              caster = self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval) or self.parent
              ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
              profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
              return interval
          end

          PlayVisualGesture(self.parent, gesture, profile.ability_duration or 0.6)
          ExecuteOrderFromTable({
              UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
              OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
              AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
              TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
              Queue = false,
          })
          ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
          if profile.follow_facing then
              profile.follow_facing_active = true
              profile.follow_facing_pos = pos
              profile.follow_facing_target = enemy
              if profile.ability_duration and profile.ability_duration > 0 then
                profile.follow_facing_end_time = now + profile.ability_duration
            else
                profile.follow_facing_end_time = nil
            end
        end
        profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
      elseif profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then
          if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsCooldownReady() then
              return 0.1
          end
          if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.PrepareCast then
              self.special_handler:PrepareCast(self, profile, enemy, pos)
          end
          local caster = self.parent
          local gesture = ResolveGestureFromKV(profile.skill_kv)
          if use_clone then
              PlayVisualGesture(self.parent, gesture, profile.ability_duration or 0.6)
              caster = self:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval) or self.parent
              ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
              profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
              return interval
          end

          PlayVisualGesture(self.parent, gesture, profile.ability_duration or 0.6)
          ExecuteOrderFromTable({
              UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
              OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
              AbilityIndex = profile.skill:entindex(),
              Queue = false,
          })
          ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)

          profile.next_cast_time = now + interval
      end

    return interval
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name)
    if not self.projectiles then return nil end

    if not ability_name then
        for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
            if profile.is_attack then
                return profile
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if profile.projectile_name == ability_name then
            return profile
        end
    end

    return nil
end

payload.message:
最优配置思路是：把“召唤/持续伤害”当作特殊弹幕槽（SP/SP2/额外槽）处理，必要时用 `clone` 让施法发生在目标点，并用 `duration` 或 `AbilityDuration` 控制克隆体停留时间与重复施法间隔。这样不改逻辑、只改配置即可覆盖召唤与持续伤害两类技能。

**方案要点**
- **召唤类**：放进 `ProjectileSP` 或 `ProjectileSP2`，`Interval` 设为召唤物持续时间（或上限-小量），避免召唤爆量；需要在目标点附近召唤时，配 `ProjectileSPDummyMode` = `clone`。
- **持续伤害/引导类**：`ProjectileDummyMode` = `clone`，`Interval` ≥ 施法持续时间；在技能 KV 里补齐 `AbilityDuration` 与 `AbilityValues.duration`（克隆体停留用的是 `duration` 特值）。
- **跟随朝向**（射线/引导）：在能力 KV 里设置 `AutoCastFollowFacing` = `1`。
- **搜敌距离**：`ProjectileRange/ProjectileSPRange` 作为“触发范围”，不能是 0，否则不会施法。

**配置模板**
1) 召唤类（示例：Invoker Forge Spirit）  
`game/dzsj/scripts/npc/item stats/shop1_items.txt`
```kv
"item_invoker_forge_spirit"
{
    "Open" "1"
    "Shop" "1"
    "HeroName" "invoker"
    "ProjectileName" "ranged_attack"
    "ProjectileInterval" "1.8 1.6 1.4 1.2 1.0 0.9"
    "ProjectileRange" "800 900 1000 1100 1200 1300"

    "ProjectileSP" "invoker_forge_spirit"
    "ProjectileSPLevel" "1 1 1 1 1 1"
    "ProjectileSPInterval" "24 30 36 42 48 54"  // 对应 spirit_duration
    "ProjectileSPRange" "1000 1000 1000 1000 1000 1000"
    "ProjectileSPDummyMode" "clone"            // 需要在目标点附近召唤时
}
```

`game/dzsj/scripts/npc/abilities/shop1_items_abilities_raw.txt`  
（补一个通用的 `duration` 供 clone 停留）
```kv
"invoker_forge_spirit"
{
    ...
    "AbilityValues"
    {
        "spirit_duration" "24 30 36 42 48 54"
        "duration"        "24 30 36 42 48 54"   // 新增：给 clone 用
    }
}
```

2) 持续伤害/引导类（示例：Phoenix Sun Ray）  
`game/dzsj/scripts/npc/item stats/shop1_items.txt`
```kv
"item_phoenix_sun_ray"
{
    "Open" "1"
    "Shop" "1"
    "HeroName" "phoenix"

    "ProjectileName" "phoenix_sun_ray"
    "ProjectileLevel" "1 1 2 2 3 4"
    "ProjectileInterval" "6.2 6.0 5.8 5.6 5.4 5.2"  // >= AbilityDuration
    "ProjectileRange" "1200 1200 1200 1200 1200 1200"
    "ProjectileDummyMode" "clone"
}
```

`game/dzsj/scripts/npc/abilities/shop1_items_abilities_raw.txt`
```kv
"phoenix_sun_ray"
{
    ...
    "AbilityDuration"        "6.0"
    "AutoCastFollowFacing"   "1"
    "AbilityValues"
    {
        ...
        "duration" "6.0"   // 新增：让 clone 停留 = 持续时间
    }
}
```

**为什么这样配**
- `clone` 模式能把施法点移动到目标位置，适合召唤/持续地面效果。
- `duration` 特值决定 clone 停留时间；没有它时会退化到 `Interval`，导致持续技能被“过早收走”或频繁重放。
- `Interval` 直接控制施法频率，是限制召唤数量和避免持续技能叠加的最关键参数。

如果你给出具体的“召唤技能/持续技能列表”，我可以按这个模板直接把 `shop1_items.txt` 和 `shop1_items_abilities_raw.txt` 写成可用配置。  
可选下一步：
1) 给我想支持的技能名列表（能力名 + 想放在哪个槽位）  
2) 我直接落地改 `game/dzsj/scripts/npc/item stats/shop1_items.txt` 和 `game/dzsj/scripts/npc/abilities/shop1_items_abilities_raw.txt`

Shop1EnhanceManager.source_index = Shop1EnhanceManager.source_index or {}

Shop1EnhanceManager.config = Shop1EnhanceManager.config or {

local RESERVED_KEYS = {
    Open = true,
    Stacks = true,
    Name = true,
    Desc = true,
    Description = true,
    Image = true,
    AbilityImage = true,
    Title = true,
}

local function ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local num = tonumber(s)
    if num then
        return num
    end

    local nums = ParseArray(s)
    if #nums > 0 then
        return nums[math.min(level, #nums)]
    end

    local strs = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #strs > 0 then
        return strs[math.min(level, #strs)]
    end

    return s
end

local function GetEnhanceWeight(cfg)
    local weight = tonumber(cfg and cfg.Weight or 1) or 1
    if weight < 0 then
        weight = 0
    end
    if weight > 1000 then
        weight = 1000
    end
    return weight
end

local function PickWeighted(list, weight_fn)
    if not list or #list == 0 then
        return nil, nil
    end
    local total = 0
    for _, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            total = total + w
        end
    end
    if total <= 0 then
        local idx = RandomInt(1, #list)
        return list[idx], idx
    end
    local roll = RandomFloat(0, total)
    local acc = 0
    for i, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            acc = acc + w
            if roll <= acc then
                return name, i
            end
        end
    end
    return list[#list], #list
end

local function ParsePercentValue(value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local trimmed = string.gsub(value, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
    local num = string.match(trimmed, "^([%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%%%s*$")
    if num then
        return tonumber(num)
    end
    return nil
end

local function ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "table" then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return tostring(raw)
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local tokens = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #tokens > 0 then
        return tokens[math.min(level, #tokens)]
    end

    return s
end

local function ResolveEnhanceNumber(raw, level, base_value)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end

    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end

    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local token = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
        if token ~= nil then
            local percent = ParsePercentValue(token)
            if percent ~= nil then
                local base = tonumber(base_value)
                if base == nil then
                    return nil
                end
                return base * (1 + percent / 100)
            end
            local numeric = tonumber(token)
            if numeric ~= nil then
                return numeric
            end
        end
    end

    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if resolved == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local percent = ParsePercentValue(resolved)
    if percent ~= nil then
        local base = tonumber(base_value)
        if base == nil then
            return nil
        end
        return base * (1 + percent / 100)
    end

    if type(resolved) == "string" then
        local numeric = tonumber(resolved)
        if numeric ~= nil then
            return numeric
        end
    end

    return resolved
end

local function SplitByPipe(raw)
    local list = {}
    if raw == nil then
        return list
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    for token in string.gmatch(s, "[^|]+") do
        local trimmed = string.gsub(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed ~= "" then
            table.insert(list, trimmed)
        end
    end
    return list
end

local function NormalizeList(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return {}
    end
    if type(raw) == "table" then
        local list = {}
        for k, v in pairs(raw) do
            table.insert(list, k)
            if v ~= nil and v ~= "" then
                table.insert(list, v)
            end
        end
        return list
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return {}
    end

    local pipe = SplitByPipe(s)
    if #pipe > 0 then
        return pipe
    end

    return { raw }
end

local function NormalizePanoramaImagePath(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return ""
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return ""
    end

    s = string.gsub(s, "%.vtex_c$", ".vtex")
    s = string.gsub(s, "^s2r://panorama/images/", "s2r://panorama/images//")

    local prefix = "panorama/images/"
    if string.sub(s, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
        return "s2r://panorama/images//" .. string.sub(s, #prefix + 1)
    end

    if string.sub(s, 1, #"s2r://") == "s2r://" then
        return s
    end

    return "s2r://" .. s
end

local function GetListValueAt(raw, index)
    local list = NormalizeList(raw)
    if #list == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local idx = math.min(index or 1, #list)
    return list[idx]
end

local function GetItemFieldValue(kv, key, level)
    if not kv or not key then
        return nil
    end
    local raw = kv[key]
    if raw == nil or raw == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local tokens = ParseStringArray(tostring(raw))
    if #tokens > 0 then
        return tokens[math.min(level or 1, #tokens)]
    end
    return raw
end

local function GetBaseStatValue(item_kv, key, level, overrides)
    if overrides and overrides[key] ~= nil then
        return tonumber(overrides[key])
    end
    if not item_kv then
        return nil
    end
    local raw
    if item_kv.AbilityValues and item_kv.AbilityValues[key] ~= nil then
        raw = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv.AbilityValues, key, level)
    else
        raw = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return tonumber(raw)
end

local function SetOverride(overrides, key, raw, level)
    if not overrides or not key then
        return
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" and raw == 0 then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local trimmed = string.gsub(raw, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed == "0" then
            return
        end
    end
    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if resolved ~= nil then
        overrides[key] = resolved
    end
end

local function SetOverrideWithBase(overrides, key, raw, level, base_value)
    if not overrides or not key then
        return
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" and raw == 0 then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local trimmed = string.gsub(raw, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed == "0" then
            return
        end
    end
    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceNumber(raw, level, base_value)
    if resolved ~= nil then
        overrides[key] = resolved
    end
end

local function ResolveSourceKey(name, hero_name)
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    if (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack") and hero_name and hero_name ~= "" then
        return hero_name .. "_" .. name
    end
    return name
end

local function ItemSourceMatchesName(cfg, raw_item_name)
    if not cfg or not raw_item_name or raw_item_name == "" then
        return false
    end
    local raw = cfg.ItemSource
    if raw == nil or raw == "" then
        return false
    end
    local list = NormalizeList(raw)
    if #list == 0 then
        return false
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(list) do
        if tostring(item) == tostring(raw_item_name) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)
    local slots = {}
    if not item_kv then
        return slots
    end

    local base = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileName", level)
    if base and base ~= "" and base ~= "none" then
        table.insert(slots, { name = base, context = "Projectile" })
    end

    for i = 1, 8 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        if item_kv[key] == nil and i > 2 then
            -- stop scanning once we are past the default slots and no explicit key exists
            if i > 3 then
                break
            end
        end
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(slots, { name = val, context = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix })
        end
    end

    return slots
end

local function CollectItemSources(item_kv, level)
    local list = {}
    if not item_kv then
        return list
    end

    local hero = item_kv.HeroName
    for _, slot in ipairs(CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)) do
        local src = ResolveSourceKey(slot.name, hero)
        if src and src ~= "" and src ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, src)
        end
    end

    local function push(key)
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, val)
        end
    end

    push("PassiveName")
    push("PassiveSP")
    push("PassiveSP2")
    for i = 3, 6 do
        push("PassiveSP" .. tostring(i))
    end
    push("AbilitySP")
    push("ModifierSP")

    return list
end

local function GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)
    if not cfg then
        return nil
    end
    local targets = NormalizeList(cfg.Projectile)
    if #targets == 0 then
        return 1
    end
    for i, name in ipairs(targets) do
        if tostring(name) == tostring(projectile_name) then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function ApplyEnhanceContext(overrides, cfg, level, context, projectile_name, item_kv, item_level)
    if not overrides or not cfg then
        return
    end

    local idx = GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)
    if idx == nil then
        return
    end

    local function set_value(prefix, raw)
        SetOverride(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level)
    end

    local function set_number(prefix, raw)
        local base_value = GetBaseStatValue(item_kv, prefix, item_level, overrides)
        SetOverrideWithBase(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level, base_value)
    end

    if context == "Projectile" then
        set_value("ProjectileName", cfg.Projectile)
        set_number("ProjectileInterval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number("ProjectileRange", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_number("ProjectileBaseDamage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
        set_value("ProjectileDamageScale", cfg.ProjectileDamageScale)
        set_value("HealPercent", cfg.HealPercent)
        set_value("PurePercent", cfg.PurePercent)
    else
        local suffix = string.sub(context, string.len("ProjectileSP") + 1)
        local prefix = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        set_value(prefix, cfg.Projectile)
        set_number(prefix .. "Interval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number(prefix .. "Range", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_number(prefix .. "BaseDamage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
        set_value(prefix .. "DamageScale", cfg.ProjectileDamageScale)
        set_value(prefix .. "PurePercent", cfg.PurePercent)
    end
end

local function IsEmptyValue(value)
    return value == nil or value == "" or value == "none" or value == "0"
end

local function GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local highest = 0
    for i = 1, 10 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end
        if not IsEmptyValue(val) then
            highest = i
        end
    end
    return highest
end

local function GetNextProjectileSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local next_idx = math.max(3, GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides) + 1)
    local suffix = (next_idx == 1) and "" or tostring(next_idx)
    return "ProjectileSP" .. suffix, next_idx
end

local function GetNextPassiveSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    for i = 1, 6 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "PassiveSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end
        if IsEmptyValue(val) then
            return key
        end
    end
    return "PassiveSP3"
end

local function ApplyEnhanceExtras(overrides, cfg, level, item_kv, item_level)

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local kv = self:GetEnhanceKV()
    return kv and kv[name] or nil
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:BuildSourceIndex()
    self.source_index = {}
    local kv = self:GetEnhanceKV() or {}
    for name, cfg in pairs(kv) do
        local sources = NormalizeList(cfg and cfg.Source)
        for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
            local key = tostring(src)
            if key ~= "" then
                self.source_index[key] = self.source_index[key] or {}
                table.insert(self.source_index[key], name)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhancesBySource(source_key)

    if not cfg then

    local stacks = tonumber(cfg.Stacks or 1) or 1

    end

    end

	end)

end
