local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function ParseAbilityCastRange(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local cast_range = ability_kv.AbilityCastRange
    if type(cast_range) == "number" then
        return cast_range
    end
    if type(cast_range) == "string" and cast_range ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(cast_range, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

local function GetCastRange(ability, caster)
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return 0
    end
    if ability.GetCastRange then
        local range = ability:GetCastRange(caster:GetAbsOrigin(), caster)
        if range and range > 0 then
            return range
        end
    end
    return ParseAbilityCastRange(ability:GetAbilityKeyValues())
end

local function BuildTargets(caster, range)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() or range <= 0 then
        return {}
    end
    return FindUnitsInRadius(
        caster:GetTeamNumber(),
        caster:GetAbsOrigin(),
        nil,
        range,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
        FIND_CLOSEST,
        false
    )
end

local PhoenixHandler = {}

local ROOTED_MODIFIER = "modifier_rooted"

local function EnsureState(context)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.phoenix = context.special_state.phoenix or {}
    return context.special_state.phoenix
end

local function SaveOrigin(state, caster)
    local pos = caster:GetAbsOrigin()
    state.icarus_origin = Vector(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
end

function PhoenixHandler:AfterCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end

    if profile.projectile_name == "phoenix_fire_spirits" then
        if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        local fire_spirits = profile.skill
        if not fire_spirits or fire_spirits:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        local spirit_count = 0
        if fire_spirits.GetSpecialValueFor then
            spirit_count = fire_spirits:GetSpecialValueFor("spirit_count") or 0
        end
        if spirit_count <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        local launch = EnsureAbility(caster, "phoenix_launch_fire_spirit", fire_spirits:GetLevel())
        if not launch then
            return false
        end

        Timers:CreateTimer(0.05, function()
            if caster:IsNull() then
                return
            end
            local range = GetCastRange(launch, caster)
            if range <= 0 then
                return
            end

            local enemies = BuildTargets(caster, range)
            if #enemies == 0 then
                return
            end

            for i = 1, spirit_count do
                local target = enemies[i]
                if not target then
                    target = enemies[((i - 1) % #enemies) + 1]
                end
                if target and not target:IsNull() then
                    ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                        UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
                        OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                        AbilityIndex = launch:entindex(),
                        Position = target:GetAbsOrigin(),
                        Queue = true,
                    })
                end
            end
        end)

        return true
    end

    if profile.projectile_name == "phoenix_icarus_dive" then
        if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        local ability = profile.skill
        if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        local state = EnsureState(context)
        local token = state.icarus_token
        local origin = state.icarus_origin
        if not origin then
            return false
        end

        local duration = 0
        if ability.GetSpecialValueFor then
            duration = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("dive_duration") or 0
        end
        if duration <= 0 then
            duration = 2.0
        end

        Timers:CreateTimer(duration, function()
            if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
                return nil
            end
            local current = context.special_state and context.special_state.phoenix
            if not current or current.icarus_token ~= token then
                return nil
            end

            caster:SetOrigin(origin)
            caster:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)

            -- FindClearSpaceForUnit(caster, origin, true)
            caster:AddNewModifier(caster, nil, ROOTED_MODIFIER, {})
            return nil
        end)

        return true
    end

    return false
end

function PhoenixHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    if not context or not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= "phoenix_icarus_dive" then
        return false
    end
    if not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    local state = EnsureState(context)
    state.icarus_token = (state.icarus_token or 0) + 1
    SaveOrigin(state, context.parent)

    if context.parent:HasModifier(ROOTED_MODIFIER) then
        context.parent:RemoveModifierByName(ROOTED_MODIFIER)
    end

    return true
end

return PhoenixHandler

local function GetRightVector(forward)
    if not forward then

    return right:Normalized()

                raw_kv = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel)
                raw_kv.AbilityValues = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel.AbilityValues or {})

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureVisualDummies(count)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    self.visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies or {}
    local need = math.max(0, (count or 1) - 1)
    local offset = GetFormationOffset(self.dummy)

    if need <= 0 then
        for _, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            if v and not v:IsNull() then
                v:Destroy()
            end
        end
        self.visual_dummies = {}
        self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = nil
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        return
    end

    while #self.visual_dummies > need do
        local v = table.remove(self.visual_dummies)
        if v and not v:IsNull() then
            v:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(self.dummy)
    local owner = self.dummy:GetOwner() or self.dummy
    local name = self.dummy:GetUnitName()

    while #self.visual_dummies < need do
        local v = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            self.dummy:GetAbsOrigin(),
            false,
            owner,
            owner,
            team
        )
        if v then
            v:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
                v:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
            end
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
            if not v:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
                v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
            end
            SetUnselectable(v, true)
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][visual] ent=%s offset=%s",
            --     tostring(v:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(offset)))
            local selectable = (v.IsUnselectable and not v:IsUnselectable()) or false
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][visual] ent=%s selectable=%s",
            --     tostring(v:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(selectable)))
            table.insert(self.visual_dummies, v)
        else
            break
        end
    end

    self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_radius)
    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    if count <= 1 then

            self.selection_proxy = proxy

                self.dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = proxy:GetEntityIndex()
            end
        end
    end

    if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
        if center_pos then
            self.selection_proxy:SetAbsOrigin(center_pos)
        end
        if max_radius and self.selection_proxy.SetHullRadius then

        end

        end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:UpdateFormationAtPos(center_pos)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    if not center_pos then
        return nil
    end

    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    self:EnsureVisualDummies(count)

    local forward = GoodForward or self.dummy:GetForwardVector() or Vector(0, 1, 0)
    local right = GetRightVector(forward)
    local base_r = GetHullRadiusSafe(self.dummy)
    local offset = GetFormationOffset(self.dummy)
    local r = base_r + offset
    local s = r * 2
    local h = s * 0.8660254

    local positions = {}
    if count == 1 then
        positions[1] = center_pos
    elseif count == 2 then
        positions[1] = center_pos - right * r
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * r
    elseif count == 3 then
        positions[1] = center_pos + forward * (2 * h / 3)
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * (-s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
        positions[3] = center_pos + right * (s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
    end

    if positions[1] then
        self.dummy:SetAbsOrigin(positions[1])
    end
    if self.visual_dummies then
        for i, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            local pos = positions[i + 1]
            if v and not v:IsNull() and pos then
                v:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
                if v.SetForwardVector then
                    v:SetForwardVector(forward)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if count > 1 then
        local max_dist = 0
        for _, pos in ipairs(positions) do
            local dist = (pos - center_pos):Length2D()
            if dist > max_dist then
                max_dist = dist
            end
        end
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_dist + r)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, true)
        if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            SetUnselectable(self.dummy_sp, true)
        end
        local main_selectable = (self.dummy.IsUnselectable and not self.dummy:IsUnselectable()) or false
        -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][main] ent=%s selectable=%s",
        --     tostring(self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()),
        --     tostring(main_selectable)))
        if self.worldPanel then
            self.worldPanel:Delete()
            self.worldPanel = nil
        end
        if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
            self:EnsureStarWorldPanelForEntity(self.selection_proxy)
        end
    else
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(nil, nil)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            SetUnselectable(self.dummy_sp, false)
        end
        local main_selectable = (self.dummy.IsUnselectable and not self.dummy:IsUnselectable()) or false
        -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][main] ent=%s selectable=%s",
        --     tostring(self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()),
        --     tostring(main_selectable)))
        if not self.worldPanel then
            self:EnsureStarWorldPanelForEntity(self.dummy)
        end
    end
    return positions[1]
end

    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_phased", {}) -- 无碰撞

local function ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local num = tonumber(s)
    if num then
        return num
    end

    local nums = ParseArray(s)
    if #nums > 0 then
        return nums[math.min(level, #nums)]
    end

    local strs = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #strs > 0 then
        return strs[math.min(level, #strs)]
    end

    return s
end

    return weight

    for _, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            total = total + w
        end
    end
    if total <= 0 then
        local idx = RandomInt(1, #list)
        return list[idx], idx
    end
    local roll = RandomFloat(0, total)
    local acc = 0
    for i, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            acc = acc + w
            if roll <= acc then
                return name, i
            end
        end
    end
    return list[#list], #list
end

local function ParsePercentValue(value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local trimmed = string.gsub(value, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
    local num = string.match(trimmed, "^([%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%%%s*$")
    if num then
        return tonumber(num)
    end
    return nil
end

local function ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "table" then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return tostring(raw)
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local tokens = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #tokens > 0 then
        return tokens[math.min(level, #tokens)]
    end

    return s
end

local function ResolveEnhanceNumber(raw, level, base_value)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end

    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end

    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local token = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
        if token ~= nil then
            local percent = ParsePercentValue(token)
            if percent ~= nil then
                local base = tonumber(base_value)
                if base == nil then
                    return nil
                end
                return base * (1 + percent / 100)
            end
            local numeric = tonumber(token)
            if numeric ~= nil then
                return numeric
            end
        end
    end

    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if resolved == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local percent = ParsePercentValue(resolved)
    if percent ~= nil then
        local base = tonumber(base_value)
        if base == nil then
            return nil
        end
        return base * (1 + percent / 100)
    end

    if type(resolved) == "string" then
        local numeric = tonumber(resolved)
        if numeric ~= nil then
            return numeric
        end
    end

    return resolved
end

local function SplitByPipe(raw)
    local list = {}
    if raw == nil then
        return list
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    for token in string.gmatch(s, "[^|]+") do
        local trimmed = string.gsub(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed ~= "" then
            table.insert(list, trimmed)
        end
    end
    return list
end

local function NormalizeList(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return {}
    end
    if type(raw) == "table" then
        local list = {}
        for k, v in pairs(raw) do
            table.insert(list, k)
            if v ~= nil and v ~= "" then
                table.insert(list, v)
            end
        end
        return list
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return {}
    end

    local pipe = SplitByPipe(s)
    if #pipe > 0 then
        return pipe
    end

    return { raw }
end

local function NormalizePanoramaImagePath(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return ""
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return ""
    end

    s = string.gsub(s, "%.vtex_c$", ".vtex")
    s = string.gsub(s, "^s2r://panorama/images/", "s2r://panorama/images//")

    local prefix = "panorama/images/"
    if string.sub(s, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
        return "s2r://panorama/images//" .. string.sub(s, #prefix + 1)
    end

    if string.sub(s, 1, #"s2r://") == "s2r://" then
        return s
    end

    return "s2r://" .. s
end

local function GetListValueAt(raw, index)
    local list = NormalizeList(raw)
    if #list == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local idx = math.min(index or 1, #list)
    return list[idx]
end

local function GetItemFieldValue(kv, key, level)
    if not kv or not key then
        return nil
    end
    local raw = kv[key]
    if raw == nil or raw == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local tokens = ParseStringArray(tostring(raw))
    if #tokens > 0 then
        return tokens[math.min(level or 1, #tokens)]
    end
    return raw
end

local function GetBaseStatValue(item_kv, key, level, overrides)
    if overrides and overrides[key] ~= nil then
        return tonumber(overrides[key])
    end
    if not item_kv then
        return nil
    end
    local raw
    if item_kv.AbilityValues and item_kv.AbilityValues[key] ~= nil then
        raw = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv.AbilityValues, key, level)
    else
        raw = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return tonumber(raw)
end

local function SetOverride(overrides, key, raw, level)
    if not overrides or not key then
        return
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" and raw == 0 then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local trimmed = string.gsub(raw, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed == "0" then
            return
        end
    end
    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if resolved ~= nil then
        overrides[key] = resolved
    end
end

local function SetOverrideWithBase(overrides, key, raw, level, base_value)
    if not overrides or not key then
        return
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" and raw == 0 then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local trimmed = string.gsub(raw, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed == "0" then
            return
        end
    end
    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceNumber(raw, level, base_value)
    if resolved ~= nil then
        overrides[key] = resolved
    end
end

local function ResolveSourceKey(name, hero_name)
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    if (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack") and hero_name and hero_name ~= "" then
        return hero_name .. "_" .. name
    end
    return name
end

local function ItemSourceMatchesName(cfg, raw_item_name)
    if not cfg or not raw_item_name or raw_item_name == "" then
        return false
    end
    local raw = cfg.ItemSource
    if raw == nil or raw == "" then
        return false
    end
    local list = NormalizeList(raw)
    if #list == 0 then
        return false
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(list) do
        if tostring(item) == tostring(raw_item_name) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)
    local slots = {}
    if not item_kv then
        return slots
    end

    local base = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileName", level)
    if base and base ~= "" and base ~= "none" then
        table.insert(slots, { name = base, context = "Projectile" })
    end

    for i = 1, 8 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        if item_kv[key] == nil and i > 2 then
            -- stop scanning once we are past the default slots and no explicit key exists
            if i > 3 then
                break
            end
        end
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(slots, { name = val, context = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix })
        end
    end

    return slots
end

local function CollectItemSources(item_kv, level)
    local list = {}
    if not item_kv then
        return list
    end

    local hero = item_kv.HeroName
    for _, slot in ipairs(CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)) do
        local src = ResolveSourceKey(slot.name, hero)
        if src and src ~= "" and src ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, src)
        end
    end

    local function push(key)
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, val)
        end
    end

    push("PassiveName")
    push("PassiveSP")
    push("PassiveSP2")
    for i = 3, 6 do
        push("PassiveSP" .. tostring(i))
    end
    push("AbilitySP")
    push("ModifierSP")

    return list
end

local function GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)
    if not cfg then
        return nil
    end
    local targets = NormalizeList(cfg.Projectile)
    if #targets == 0 then
        return 1
    end
    for i, name in ipairs(targets) do
        if tostring(name) == tostring(projectile_name) then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function ApplyEnhanceContext(overrides, cfg, level, context, projectile_name, item_kv, item_level)
    if not overrides or not cfg then
        return
    end

    local idx = GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)
    if idx == nil then
        return
    end

    local function set_value(prefix, raw)
        SetOverride(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level)
    end

    local function set_number(prefix, raw)
        local base_value = GetBaseStatValue(item_kv, prefix, item_level, overrides)
        SetOverrideWithBase(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level, base_value)
    end

    if context == "Projectile" then
        set_value("ProjectileName", cfg.Projectile)
        set_number("ProjectileInterval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number("ProjectileRange", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_number("ProjectileBaseDamage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
        set_value("ProjectileDamageScale", cfg.ProjectileDamageScale)
        set_value("HealPercent", cfg.HealPercent)
        set_value("PurePercent", cfg.PurePercent)
    else
        local suffix = string.sub(context, string.len("ProjectileSP") + 1)
        local prefix = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        set_value(prefix, cfg.Projectile)
        set_number(prefix .. "Interval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number(prefix .. "Range", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_number(prefix .. "BaseDamage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
        set_value(prefix .. "DamageScale", cfg.ProjectileDamageScale)
        set_value(prefix .. "PurePercent", cfg.PurePercent)
    end
end

local function IsEmptyValue(value)
    return value == nil or value == "" or value == "none" or value == "0"
end

local function GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local highest = 0
    for i = 1, 10 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end
        if not IsEmptyValue(val) then
            highest = i
        end
    end
    return highest
end

local function GetNextProjectileSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local next_idx = math.max(3, GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides) + 1)
    local suffix = (next_idx == 1) and "" or tostring(next_idx)
    return "ProjectileSP" .. suffix, next_idx
end

local function GetNextPassiveSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    for i = 1, 6 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "PassiveSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end
        if IsEmptyValue(val) then
            return key
        end
    end
    return "PassiveSP3"
end

local function ApplyEnhanceExtras(overrides, cfg, level, item_kv, item_level)
    if not overrides or not cfg or not item_kv then
        return
    end

    local additional_list = NormalizeList(cfg.AdditionalProjectile)
    for i, name in ipairs(additional_list) do
        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
            local slot_key, slot_idx = GetNextProjectileSlotKey(item_kv, item_level, overrides)
            local suffix = (slot_idx == 1) and "" or tostring(slot_idx)

            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key, name, level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Level", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileLevel, i),
                level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Interval",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileInterval, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Range",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileRange, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "BaseDamage",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileBaseDamage, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "DamageScale",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileDamageScale, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "PurePercent",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalPurePercent, i), level)
        end
    end

    local passive_list = NormalizeList(cfg.Passive)
    for i, name in ipairs(passive_list) do
        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
            local slot_key = GetNextPassiveSlotKey(item_kv, item_level, overrides)
            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key, name, level)
            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key .. "Level", GetListValueAt(cfg.PassiveLevel, i), level)
        end
    end

    local ability_sp = GetListValueAt(cfg.AbilitySP, 1)
    if not IsEmptyValue(ability_sp) then
        SetOverride(overrides, "AbilitySP", ability_sp, level)
    end

    local modifier_sp = GetListValueAt(cfg.ModifierSP, 1)
    if not IsEmptyValue(modifier_sp) then
        SetOverride(overrides, "ModifierSP", modifier_sp, level)
    end

    SetOverride(overrides, "LifestealSP", GetListValueAt(cfg.LifestealSP, 1), level)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceKV()
    local kv = Shop1EnhanceKV or {}
    if kv["Shop1 Items Enhance"] then
        kv = kv["Shop1 Items Enhance"]
    end
    return kv
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local kv = self:GetEnhanceKV()
    return kv and kv[name] or nil
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:BuildSourceIndex()
    self.source_index = {}
    local kv = self:GetEnhanceKV() or {}
    for name, cfg in pairs(kv) do
        local sources = NormalizeList(cfg and cfg.Source)
        for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
            local key = tostring(src)
            if key ~= "" then
                self.source_index[key] = self.source_index[key] or {}
                table.insert(self.source_index[key], name)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhancesBySource(source_key)
    if not source_key or source_key == "" then
        return {}
    end
    return self.source_index[source_key] or {}
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return 1
    end
    local stacks = tonumber(cfg.Stacks or 1) or 1
    if stacks == -1 then
        return -1
    end
    if stacks < 1 then
        stacks = 1
    end
    return stacks
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return false
    end
    return tonumber(cfg.Open or 0) == 1
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:HasSourceMatch(item_sources, cfg_sources)
    if not item_sources or not cfg_sources then
        return false
    end
    for _, src in ipairs(cfg_sources) do
        local target = tostring(src)
        if target ~= "" then
            for _, item_src in ipairs(item_sources) do
                if tostring(item_src) == target then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:EnsureState(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return nil
    end
    if not self.states[pid] then
        self.states[pid] = {
            pool_list = {},
            pool_map = {},
            purchased = {},
            selection = nil,
        }
    end
    return self.states[pid]
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:Init()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true

    self:BuildSourceIndex()

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_request", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceRequest(event)
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_choice", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceChoice(event)
    end)

end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:InitPlayer(pid)
    self:EnsureState(pid)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return 0
    end
    return state.purchased[name] or 0
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:SetPurchasedCount(pid, name, count)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    state.purchased[name] = count
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, name)
    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state or not name or name == "" or name == "none" then
        return false
    end

    if state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end

    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
        return false
    end

    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    if stacks ~= -1 then
        local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
        if purchased >= stacks then
            return false
        end
    end

    table.insert(state.pool_list, name)
    state.pool_map[name] = true
    return true
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, source_key)
    local changed = false
    for _, name in ipairs(self:GetEnhancesBySource(source_key)) do
        changed = self:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, name) or changed
    end
    return changed
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:RemoveEnhanceFromPool(pid, name)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return false
    end
    if not state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end
    state.pool_map[name] = nil

    for i = #state.pool_list, 1, -1 do
        if state.pool_list[i] == name then
            table.remove(state.pool_list, i)
            break
        end
    end
    return true
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPoolList(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state then
        return {}
    end
    return state.pool_list
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:IsUnlocked(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return true
    end
    if not SpawnWallManager or not SpawnWallManager.GetExpansionProgress then
        return true
    end
    local _, _, count = SpawnWallManager:GetExpansionProgress(pid)
    count = tonumber(count or 0) or 0
    return count >= 5
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    local pool_count = (state and state.pool_list and #state.pool_list) or 0
    return {
        unlocked = self:IsUnlocked(pid),
        available = pool_count > 0,
        pool_count = pool_count,
    }
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(pid, raw_item_name, level)
    if not raw_item_name or raw_item_name == "" then
        return false
    end

    local kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[raw_item_name]
    if not kv then
        return false
    end

    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1
    local changed = false
    for _, src in ipairs(CollectItemSources(kv, lvl)) do
        changed = self:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, src) or changed
    end

    return changed
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, raw_item_name, level, kv)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not raw_item_name then
        return nil
    end

    local item_kv = kv or (Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[raw_item_name])
    if not item_kv then
        return nil
    end

    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1
    local item_sources = CollectItemSources(item_kv, lvl)
    local overrides = {}
    local applied = false
    local applied_extra = {}

    for enhance_name, count in pairs(state.purchased or {}) do
        if count and count > 0 then
            local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(enhance_name)
            if self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
                local cfg_sources = NormalizeList(cfg.Source)
                if self:HasSourceMatch(item_sources, cfg_sources) then
                    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
                    local enhance_level = (stacks == -1) and count or math.min(count, stacks)
                    for _, slot in ipairs(CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, lvl)) do
                        ApplyEnhanceContext(overrides, cfg, enhance_level, slot.context, slot.name, item_kv, lvl)
                    end
                    if not applied_extra[enhance_name] then
                        ApplyEnhanceExtras(overrides, cfg, enhance_level, item_kv, lvl)
                        applied_extra[enhance_name] = true
                    end
                    applied = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not applied then
        return nil
    end

    return overrides
end

local function InferEnhanceDescType(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return "text"
    end

    local add_proj = GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectile, 1)
    if add_proj and add_proj ~= "" and add_proj ~= "none" then
        return "compound"
    end

    if cfg.ProjectileInterval or cfg.ProjectileRange or cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage then
        return "values"
    end

    return "text"
end

local function BuildEnhanceDescVars(cfg, level)
    local vars = {}
    if not cfg then
        return vars
    end

    local desc_type = InferEnhanceDescType(cfg)
    if desc_type == "text" then
        return vars
    end

    local function set_var(key, raw)
        local val = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
        if val ~= nil and val ~= "" then
            vars[key] = val
        end
    end

    if desc_type == "compound" then
        local add_name = GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectile, 1)
        if add_name and add_name ~= "" and add_name ~= "none" then
            vars["additional_projectile"] = "#DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_" .. tostring(add_name)
        end
        set_var("additional_projectile_level", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileLevel, 1))
        set_var("additional_projectile_interval", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileInterval, 1))
        set_var("additional_projectile_range", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileRange, 1))
        set_var("additional_projectile_damage", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileBaseDamage, 1))
    else
        set_var("interval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_var("range", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_var("damage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
    end

    return vars
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:BuildChoicePayload(name, pid)
    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name) or {}
    local level = 1
    if pid then
        local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
        local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
        level = purchased + 1
        if stacks ~= -1 then
            level = math.min(level, stacks)
        end
        if level < 1 then
            level = 1
        end
    end

    local desc_type = InferEnhanceDescType(cfg)
    local display_name = cfg.Name
    local display_desc = cfg.Desc or cfg.Description
    if not display_name or display_name == "" then
        display_name = "#shop1_enhance_" .. tostring(name) .. "_name"
    end
    if not display_desc or display_desc == "" then
        if desc_type == "compound" then
            display_desc = "#shop1_enhance_desc_additional_projectile"
        elseif desc_type == "values" then
            display_desc = "#shop1_enhance_desc_projectile_stats"
        else
            display_desc = "#shop1_enhance_" .. tostring(name) .. "_desc"
        end
    end

    local payload = {
        ability = name or "",
        image = NormalizePanoramaImagePath(cfg.Image),
        display_name = display_name or "",
        display_desc = display_desc or "",
        display_desc_vars = BuildEnhanceDescVars(cfg, level),
    }

    if payload.image == "" and name and name ~= "" then
        payload.image = "s2r://panorama/images/spellicons/" .. name .. "_png.vtex"
    end

    return payload
end

function modifier_dummy_cast:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_dummy_cast:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_dummy_cast:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_dummy_cast:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

local function HasBehavior(behavior, flag)
    return behavior and string.find(behavior, flag, 1, true)
end

local function ResolveCastBehavior(ability_kv)
    local behavior = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""
    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT") then
        return "Position"
    end

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET") then
        local target_team = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityUnitTargetTeam or ""
        if HasBehavior(target_team, "DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_FRIENDLY") then
            return "Self"
        end
        return "Target"
    end

    if HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") then
        return "NoTarget"
    end

    return "NoTarget"
end

function modifier_dummy_cast:OnCreated(kv)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    self.parent            = self:GetParent() -- dummy
    self.ability_name      = kv.ability_name
    self.ability           = self.parent:FindAbilityByName(self.ability_name)
    local ab_kv            = AbilityKV[self.ability_name]
    self.behavior          = ResolveCastBehavior(ab_kv)

    self.ability._is_skill = true

    self.owner             = self:GetCaster()

    self.attacker_override = self.owner
    self.base_damage       = kv.skill_base_damage or 0
    self.hit_label         = "skill"
    self.pure_percent      = kv.pure_percent or 0

    print("[Skill]", self.owner:GetUnitName(), self.base_damage, self.hit_label)

    -- print("[modifier_dummy_cast Create]", kv.ability_name, kv, self.behavior)

    self.skill = self.parent:FindAbilityByName(self.ability_name)
end

function modifier_dummy_cast:Cast(target_index, pos)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    if self.behavior == "NoTarget" then
        --print("cast no target")

        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = self.skill:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    elseif self.behavior == "Self" then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = self.skill:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
    elseif self.behavior == "Position" then
        local cast_pos = pos
        if not cast_pos and target_index then
            local target = EntIndexToHScript(target_index)
            if target and not target:IsNull() then
                cast_pos = target:GetAbsOrigin()
            end
        end
        if not cast_pos then
            return
        end

        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
            AbilityIndex = self.skill:entindex(),
            Position = cast_pos,
            Queue = false,
        })
    elseif self.behavior == "Target" then
        local target = EntIndexToHScript(target_index)
        if not target then
            return
        end

        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = self.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = self.skill:entindex(),
            TargetIndex = target_index,
            Queue = false,
        })
    end
end

LinkLuaModifier("modifier_dummy_autocast",
    "projectiles/modifier_dummy_autocast.lua", LUA_MODIFIER_MOTION_NONE)

modifier_ability_autocast_controller = class({})

function modifier_ability_autocast_controller:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_ability_autocast_controller:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_ability_autocast_controller:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_ability_autocast_controller:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_ability_autocast_controller:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent  = self:GetParent()

    local ability = self:GetAbility()

    if not ability then return end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        local name   = ability:GetAbilityName()

        local raw_kv = ability:GetAbilityKeyValues()
        local type   = 1
        if raw_kv and raw_kv.Shop then
            type = tonumber(raw_kv.Shop)
        end


        local stats_kv = {}
        if type == 1 then
            stats_kv = Shop1ItemsKV[name] or {}
        elseif type == 2 then
            stats_kv = Shop2ItemsKV[name] or {}
        elseif type == 3 then
            stats_kv = Shop3ItemsKV[name] or {}
        elseif type == 0 then
            stats_kv = PersistentItemsKV[name] or {}
        end

        local lvl                   = ability.custom_level
        self.projectile_name        = stats_kv.ProjectileName
        self.passive_name           = stats_kv.PassiveName
        self.projectile_interval    = ParseArray(stats_kv.ProjectileInterval)[lvl]
        self.projectile_range       = ParseArray(stats_kv.ProjectileRange)[lvl]
        self.projectile_base_damage = ParseArray(stats_kv.ProjectileBaseDamage)[lvl]

        --DebugPrint("Ability name", self.projectile_name, "lvl", lvl, "interval", self.projectile_interval)

        if self.projectile_interval <= 0 then
            self.projectile_interval = 2.0
        end
        if self.projectile_range <= 0 then
            self.projectile_range = 800
        end

        self.dummy = CreateUnitByName(
            "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy",
            Vector(10000, 10000, 0),
            false,
            parent,
            parent,
            parent:GetTeamNumber()
        )

        if not self.dummy then return end

        self.dummy:SetOwner(parent)
        self.dummy:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
        --self.dummy:FollowEntity(parent, false)

        Timers:CreateTimer(function()
            if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then return end

            if not parent or parent:IsNull() or parent.__is_evolving then
                return
            end

            self.dummy:SetAbsOrigin(parent:GetAbsOrigin())
            return 0.03
        end)

        self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
        self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_phased", {}) -- 无碰撞
        self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {}) -- 不移动（保险）

        -- 给 dummy 挂自动施法 modifier
        self.dummy:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", {
            projectile_name        = self.projectile_name,
            projectile_interval    = self.projectile_interval,
            projectile_range       = self.projectile_range,
            projectile_base_damage = self.projectile_base_damage,
            passive_name           = self.passive_name,
        })
    end)
end

function modifier_ability_autocast_controller:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    print("[Modifier OnDestroy]", self:GetName())

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        self.dummy:Destroy()
        self.dummy = nil
    end
end

		local destination_z = filter_table.position_z
		local unit_with_order
		if units["0"] then
			unit_with_order = EntIndexToHScript(units["0"])
		end

		if unit_with_order and playerID ~= nil and Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[playerID] then
			local mgr = Shop1Managers[playerID]
			local slot = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit_with_order)

				end

				end

- `EffectName/EffectInterval/EffectRange/EffectBaseDamage/EffectDamageScale/EffectHealPercent/EffectPurePercent` 是“技能衍生出来的单位/效果”的配置。
- `EffectName` 用来匹配 **哪个技能 A**；当 A 被自动施放后，如果 A 召唤出单位 B（你举的例子），就把 `Effect*` 这一组数值应用到 B 上。
- 这些字段允许多个条目，**按顺序一一对应**。
- `shop1_items_enhance.txt` 里新增的 `Effect*` / `AdditionalEffect*` 是强化覆盖/追加，同样需要生效（示例是 `drow_ranger_ranged_attack_2`）。
- 具体应用要走 `autocast_specials` 框架，但不在 `autocast_specials.lua` 里加 drow 的特殊分支（用通用处理）。

**我准备的实现方式（请确认）**
- 在 `modifier_item_autocast_controller.lua` 里把 item 的 `Effect*`（含强化后的）整理成一个“效果列表”，挂到 dummy 上（例如 `dummy.__autocast_effects`），给 `modifier_dummy_autocast` 使用。

I’ll implement helper functions for normalizing lists and resolving values by level, and integrate effect data into the item autocast controller and enhancements manager while carefully managing how effect tables are stored and passed around.  local M = {}
 
+local function SplitByPipe(raw)
+    local list = {}
+    if raw == nil then
+        return list
+    end
+    local s = tostring(raw)
+    for token in string.gmatch(s, "[^|]+") do
+        local trimmed = string.gsub(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
+        if trimmed ~= "" then
+            table.insert(list, trimmed)
+        end
+    end
+    return list
+end
+
+local function NormalizeList(raw)
+    if raw == nil then
+        return {}
+    end
+    if type(raw) == "table" then
+        local list = {}
+        local numeric_keys = {}
+        local has_numeric = false
+        for k, v in pairs(raw) do
+            if type(k) == "number" then
+                has_numeric = true
+                table.insert(numeric_keys, k)
+            else
+                table.insert(list, k)
+                if v ~= nil and v ~= "" then
+                    table.insert(list, v)
+                end
+            end
+        end
+        if has_numeric then
+            table.sort(numeric_keys)
+            for _, k in ipairs(numeric_keys) do
+                local v = raw[k]
+                if v ~= nil and v ~= "" then
+                    table.insert(list, v)
+                end
+            end
+        end
+        return list
+    end
+    local s = tostring(raw)
+    if s == "" then
+        return {}
+    end
+    local pipe = SplitByPipe(s)
+    if #pipe > 0 then
+        return pipe
+    end
+    return { raw }
+end
+
+local function GetListValueAt(raw, index)
+    local list = NormalizeList(raw)
+    if #list == 0 then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local idx = math.min(index or 1, #list)
+    return list[idx]
+end
+
+local function ResolveLevelValue(raw, level)
+    if raw == nil then
+        return nil
+    end
+    if type(raw) == "number" then
+        return raw
+    end
+    local s = tostring(raw)
+    if s == "" then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local nums = ParseArray(s)
+    if #nums > 0 then
+        return nums[math.min(level or 1, #nums)]
+    end
+    local strs = ParseStringArray(s)
+    if #strs > 0 then
+        return strs[math.min(level or 1, #strs)]
+    end
+    return s
+end
+
+local function ReadEffectList(raw_kv, level, prefix)
+    if not raw_kv then
+        return {}
+    end
+    local name_key = prefix .. "Name"
+    local names = NormalizeList(raw_kv[name_key])
+    if #names == 0 then
+        return {}
+    end
+
+    local list = {}
+    for i, raw_name in ipairs(names) do
+        local name = common.NormalizeName(raw_name)
+        if name then
+            table.insert(list, {
+                name = name,
+                interval = ResolveLevelValue(GetListValueAt(raw_kv[prefix .. "Interval"], i), level),
+                range = ResolveLevelValue(GetListValueAt(raw_kv[prefix .. "Range"], i), level),
+                base_damage = ResolveLevelValue(GetListValueAt(raw_kv[prefix .. "BaseDamage"], i), level),
+                damage_scale = ResolveLevelValue(GetListValueAt(raw_kv[prefix .. "DamageScale"], i), level),
+                heal_percent = ResolveLevelValue(GetListValueAt(raw_kv[prefix .. "HealPercent"], i), level),
+                pure_percent = ResolveLevelValue(GetListValueAt(raw_kv[prefix .. "PurePercent"], i), level),
+            })
+        end
+    end
+
+    return list
+end
+
+function M.ReadEffects(raw_kv, level, prefix)
+    return ReadEffectList(raw_kv, level, prefix or "Effect")
+end
+
